entities.name: Captain Dapplewing's Manor
entities.description: A two-story residence on the Central Campus of Strixhaven University, now a faculty annex used for academic counseling and social functions.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The university on Arcavios that inherited the manor.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which Strixhaven University stands.

entities.name: Raymous Dapplewing
entities.description: An owlin mage and military officer who served on the faculties of Lorehold and Silverquill and built the manor.

entities.name: Lorehold College
entities.description: A college of Strixhaven where Dapplewing served.

entities.name: Silverquill College
entities.description: A college of Strixhaven where Dapplewing served; its professors help provide campus security.

entities.name: Quandrix College
entities.description: A college whose security professors respond to vandalism at the manor.

entities.name: The Earl
entities.description: A clockwork butler that guards the Grand Hall at night.

events.summary: Captain Dapplewing builds the manor with his pension as a place to retire and host dinner parties.
events.quote: Using his generous pension, he built the home as a place to retire and host lavish dinner parties that often turned into late-night academic colloquiums.

events.summary: On his death Dapplewing bequeaths the manor to Strixhaven University, which repurposes it as a faculty annex.
events.quote: Upon his passing, Captain Dapplewing bequeathed the manor to Strixhaven University.

relations.quote: The house was constructed by Captain Raymous Dapplewing , an owlin mage and military officer
who served on the faculties of both Lorehold College and Silverquill College.
